authorization: 2026-10-13 user-approved full v2 deployment and real experiments

scenarios.procedure: Fresh team, H01 and F01 separate spaces; save real EX-PAY, EX-ACCEPT and EX-LIABILITY feedback and retrieve all three from the second contract.
scenarios.expect: Correct source versions and conditions; no automatic feedback or report rewrite.

scenarios.procedure: Review a new space from the opposite transaction role and query the same risk.
Copy a review scheme through the UI API, create a report using it, then update its payment standard and query again.
scenarios.expect: Historical standard difference shown; applicability downgraded.

scenarios.procedure: Update a saved feedback to judgment incorrect, then withdraw it; check both history and recall.
scenarios.expect: Original report retained; current case version and eligibility change.

scenarios.procedure: Two teams for one user, another same-team member and another application organization; request real personal entries, report and candidate IDs under other identities.
scenarios.expect: Denied reads and writes; no personal contract details leaked.

scenarios.procedure: User manually saves a permission-test experience, submits sanitized sharing text, member attempts approval, admin approves, then remove the member.
scenarios.expect: No team visibility before approval, publication afterward, restricted sources, immediate subsequent denial after removal.

scenarios.procedure: Establish and confirm a long-term preference; later issue a conflicting long-term preference; inspect conflict, stale version and explicit human resolution.
scenarios.expect: No automatic replacement; conflict references correct version; stale update rejected.

scenarios.procedure: Ignore an actual candidate and observe later source processing.
scenarios.expect: Same source does not repeatedly prompt.

scenarios.procedure: Read legacy history and exercise authenticated legacy write endpoints against a managed contract Agent.
scenarios.expect: Legacy retained, absent from v2 views; write bypass denied.

scenarios.procedure: Use ordinary provider in a fresh session; separately open a connected report.
scenarios.expect: No new business memory capture or identity injection; report lookup remains independently scoped.

scenarios.procedure: Observe real title/compaction request classification and associated L0 snapshots.
scenarios.expect: Auxiliary request skips business memory capture and injection.

scenarios.procedure: Capture read-only state, restart app/Core/Proxy, resume checkpoint and compare versions/tombstones.
Stop contract Proxy during an isolated test request, observe visible failure, restore and retry normally.
scenarios.expect: No model fallback or false memory receipt; recovery succeeds.

scenarios.procedure: Stop structured bridge during test feedback extraction, preserve saved feedback and failed jobs, restore bridge and invoke allowed retry.
scenarios.expect: Saved feedback survives, failure is observable, replay produces no duplicate case.

scenarios.procedure: Repeat idempotent confirmation and submit stale concurrent edits; repeat feedback delivery through normal retry.
scenarios.expect: Single publication, 409 stale edit, stable case identity/version.

scenarios.procedure: Separate fresh browser team: upload/read, report and source navigation, feedback, candidate confirmation, cross-session recall, sharing review, downloaded report; inspect light/dark cards.
scenarios.expect: Visible receipts match persisted state and actual tool results.
